FIRE ALERT 

Sumiklab ang sunog sa isang residential area sa Basilio St. corner Florentino sa Sampaloc, Manila ngayong Linggo, June 15. 

Itinaas ito hanggang ikalawang alarma. Idineklara rin itong fire under control bandang 5:17 a.m. ngayong araw.

data.text: Fire hits residential area in Sampaloc, Manila https://t.co/IQlVc5VHYV

value.string_value: A fire broke out at a residential area in Sampaloc, Manila, early Sunday morning, according to the Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP).

More than 850 residents from 243 families have sought shelter in evacuation centers in Manila as persistent rains from the enhanced southwest monsoon, or habagat, continued to affect the city on Monday.
